KreditBee.summary: Personal loans from lending partners, plus UPI transfers and merchant payments.

requirements.label: Salaried personal loan
requirements.text: Indian citizens above 21 in regular or permanent employment, with three months at their current company, salary of at least ₹10,000/month and household income above ₹25,000/month. PAN, a photo, address and employment proof, salary bank statements, an Aadhaar-linked mobile number and credit assessment are required.

requirements.label: Other personal loans
requirements.text: Age rules conflict: 18+ with no upper limit in the FAQ, versus 21–60 in the general loan calculator. The calculator also requires monthly income of at least ₹10,000.

requirements.label: UPI
requirements.text: Verify your mobile number, link a bank account and set a UPI PIN.

notes: Confirm the age rule for your chosen loan before applying.
UPI minimum age not confirmed.

RapiPay.summary: Retailer outlets provide assisted cash withdrawals, money transfers, bill payments and other financial services.

requirements.label: Retailer agent
requirements.text: Apply with a mobile number and use a smartphone or computer. Identity and address details and photographs must be verified and approved before activation.

requirements.label: Joining under an existing agent
requirements.text: Provide PAN, address proof and a live photograph holding your identity documents. RapiPay must approve the request.

notes: Minimum agent age, joining fees and required operating balance not confirmed.
Confirm the current document checklist and equipment needed for each service when joining.

Spice Money.summary: Shop-based Adhikari outlets offer assisted withdrawals, transfers, bill payments, recharges and other financial services.

requirements.label: Adhikari agent
requirements.text: Register with a mobile number and provide your shop address, PAN, Aadhaar and bank details. A representative visits to verify your shop and KYC details; approval is required before agent credentials are issued.

notes: Minimum agent age, joining fees and required operating balance not confirmed.
Equipment and customer requirements vary by service.

Saathi by PayNearby.summary: UPI payments, bills, recharges and mutual-fund investing, with optional help from nearby retailers.

requirements.label: App registration
requirements.text: Allow SMS access for device verification during registration.

requirements.label: Identity verification
requirements.text: Identity documents may be requested for verification or e-KYC.

requirements.label: Mutual funds
requirements.text: Investments start at ₹100.

notes: UPI minimum age, residency, eligible accounts and bank-linking steps not confirmed.
Mutual-fund provider, investor eligibility and KYC steps not confirmed.

Dhani.summary: Short-term personal loans for salaried applicants.

requirements.label: Salaried personal loan
requirements.text: Indian citizens aged 21–58, with salary paid into a bank account, PAN linked to Aadhaar and an Aadhaar-linked mobile number. PAN-based identity and credit checks, Aadhaar OTP e-KYC, a bank statement, an in-app selfie and lender approval are required.

notes: Minimum salary and credit-score cutoff not confirmed.

Fave.summary: UPI payments with shared expense tracking, bill splitting and a household bill calendar.
notes: UPI joining requirements not confirmed.

True Balance.summary: Personal loans from lending partners, plus UPI-enabled wallet transfers and merchant payments.

requirements.label: Personal loan
requirements.text: Indian citizens aged 18+ need identity and address proof, PAN, Aadhaar and KYC. The initial eligibility check uses a soft credit enquiry; formal applications include a credit check.

requirements.label: Cash Loan
requirements.text: Register a phone number, complete KYC, provide bank statements and bank details, and set up auto-debit. Approval depends on the lender's assessment.

requirements.label: Repeat borrowing
requirements.text: One active loan at a time. You can apply again after repayment, subject to lender approval.

notes: Upper age limits, minimum income and credit-score cutoffs for each loan not confirmed.
Level Up Loan eligibility not confirmed.
UPI and wallet joining requirements, including KYC levels, not confirmed.

Payworld.summary: Retailers provide assisted cash withdrawals, transfers, bill payments, recharges and travel bookings.

requirements.label: Retailer account
requirements.text: 18+ and legally able to enter a binding contract. Register with a mobile number, email and pincode, verify mobile and email OTPs, and give the required consent; additional service-provider terms apply.

notes: KYC documents, activation steps, fees and required operating balance not confirmed.
Equipment and authorisation requirements for individual services need confirmation.

Snapmint.summary: Cardless EMI shopping, plus UPI for eligible users and personal loans for premium customers.

requirements.label: Purchase limit / EMI loan
requirements.text: 18+, legally able to contract and meeting the lender's insolvency and other contractual conditions. Financing needs approval, KYC, verification and a repayment mandate; PAN, Aadhaar and phone details may be requested.

requirements.label: Personal loan
requirements.text: Available to premium customers.

notes: Minimum income, credit-score cutoffs, credit limits and premium-customer criteria not confirmed.
UPI age and account requirements not confirmed.
Fees and interest depend on the offer; a no-cost EMI label does not cover every purchase or loan.

ZET.summary: Bank-issued credit cards backed by fixed deposits, including the SBM ZET card.

requirements.label: SBM ZET credit card
requirements.text: Create an eligible FD in your sole name through ZET, complete video KYC and receive bank approval; the bank places a lien on the deposit before card activation. No prior credit history or income proof is needed.

requirements.label: SBM ZET card deposit
requirements.text: Minimum FD amounts conflict: ₹2,000 on ZET's product page and ₹5,000 in SBM's card agreement. Confirm the amount in your offer before depositing.

notes: Card-specific age and residency limits not confirmed.
IOB and DCB card requirements not confirmed.

Navi.summary: UPI payments, loans, mutual funds and insurance through separate service providers.

requirements.label: Navi account
requirements.text: You must be legally able to contract. Create a profile with a phone number verified by OTP.

requirements.label: Bank-account UPI
requirements.text: India residents need an active account with a participating bank, linked to their mobile number. Registration sends an SMS from the device; the linked SIM must stay active.

requirements.label: Finserv personal loan
requirements.text: Annual household income above ₹3,00,000 and legal capacity to contract; household includes spouses and unmarried adult children. Requested information and documents, approved KYC, bank verification and lender credit approval are required.

requirements.label: Navi Trezo credit line on UPI
requirements.text: Annual household income above ₹1,20,000 and legal capacity to contract. Partner lenders carry out KYC and decide credit approval.

requirements.label: Mutual funds
requirements.text: Provide requested investor details and documents, including PAN and Aadhaar, and meet KYC/CKYC requirements. Each scheme's terms also apply.

requirements.label: Insurance
requirements.text: Indian nationals who can legally contract and are not politically exposed. Acceptance depends on the insurer and policy terms.

notes: Loan age limits, minimum personal salary and credit-score cutoffs not confirmed.
Insurance age limits and scheme-specific investment limits not confirmed.
Trezo requirements may differ by offer; check your lender's terms.
